_comment: P2P CDN Seeder - Pterodactyl Egg Configuration
name: P2P CDN Seeder
author: your@email.com
description: P2P CDN Daemon/Seeder node. Connects to a tracker and seeds files to peers via libp2p/BitSwap.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "====================================="
echo "P2P CDN Seeder Installation"
echo "====================================="
echo ""

# Create data directory
mkdir -p .p2pcdn/data

# Give the container user full write access to the entire server directory
chmod -R 777 /mnt/server

echo "Installation complete."
echo ""
echo "Next steps:"
echo "1. Upload your 'p2pcdn-daemon' binary (Linux/amd64) to /home/container/"
echo "2. Set the egg variables (TRACKER_URL, P2P_PORT, etc.)"
echo "3. Start the server (chmod +x is applied automatically on startup)"

variables.name: Tracker URL
variables.description: Full URL of the P2P CDN tracker. Example: http://190.115.198.31:50000

variables.name: P2P Listen Port
variables.description: Port used for libp2p P2P connections (TCP and UDP). Must be open in the firewall.

variables.name: Daemon API Port
variables.description: Internal HTTP port for the daemon API (used by p2pcdn CLI to communicate with the daemon).

variables.name: External IP
variables.description: Public IP address of this server (e.g. 190.115.198.31). Required for P2P connections from outside the container network.
